item.title: Developer-side validation during implementation
item.intent: The developer agent must run the validation command during the harden phase of the maturity protocol so it catches failures inside the session where context is hot — not after the cycle ends.
item.description: Currently the developer flies blind until the orchestrator runs validation post-cycle. The developer has Bash permission and could self-check but is never told to. Inject the validation command into the maturity protocol harden phase instructions.
steps: In aishore build_agent_prompt, find the maturity protocol injection section
In the Phase 3 Harden text, add an instruction to run the validation command and fix failures before committing
Only inject this instruction when VALIDATE_CMD is non-empty
In agents/developer.md, in the Harden phase description, add a note that the validation command will be provided by the orchestrator
acceptanceCriteria: When VALIDATE_CMD is configured, the developer agent prompt includes the validation command in the Harden phase instructions
When VALIDATE_CMD is empty, no validation instruction is injected
The developer agent can run the validation command during implementation via its existing Bash permission
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
